courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Solar Impulse 太陽能飛機
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「退役構型與部件身份」推進到「材料鑑別取樣」，最後以「部件再利用及材料回收分流交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Retired configuration and part identity through Material-identification sampling to Separate component-reuse and recycling handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 飛機退役拆解與再利用
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「退役構型與部件身份」推進到「材料鑑別取樣」，最後以「部件再利用及材料回收分流交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Retired configuration and part identity through Material-identification sampling to Separate component-reuse and recycling handoff. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「把可追溯部件再利用與材料回收分成兩條流程」為主線，在虛構退役飛機資產與材料帳本中依序完成退役構型與部件身份、目標材料回收率、材料鑑別取樣、搬移前的假想質量分布、錯誤身份與污染的流程失效及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Separate traceable component reuse from material recycling in a Fictional retired-aircraft asset and material ledger, progressing through Retired configuration and part identity, Target-material recovery, Material-identification sampling, Hypothetical mass distribution before relocation, Process failures from wrong identity and contamination, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
